title: Simulation 3D Probabilistic Radar Configuration
text: 在 3D 仿真环境中配置概率雷达特征；按 {Radar cross sections (dBsm)} 指定雷达截面积；{Radar targets} 指定对应于雷达目标的标识符、{Default radar cross section (dBsm)} 指定默认雷达截面积，按实例取值。

params.name: Radar targets
params.values: 对应于雷达目标的标识符 [] (default) | positive integer | L -length vector of unique positive integers

params.name: Radar cross sections (dBsm)
params.values: 雷达截面积 {} (default) | real-valued Q -by- P matrix | L -length cell array of real-valued Q 1 -by- P 1, …, Q L -by- P L matrices

params.name: Default radar cross section (dBsm)
params.values: 默认雷达截面积 -20 (default) | real scalar
